            ans = powerMod(diff, n * m, mod);

            long pp2 = Math.abs(p1 - p2);

            long opt2 = powerMod(pp2, n * m, mod);

            ans = (opt * inv2) % mod;

        long result = 1;

            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % mod;

            exp >>= 1;
